stories.title: Defending champs are back in the semifinals: How the Aces eliminated the Fever
stories.summary: Las Vegas eliminated Indiana to return to the WNBA semifinals.

stories.title: Braves break out 'warrior' Sale to close out Phils in wild-card clincher
stories.summary: On one day of rest, Braves ace Chris Sale turned in an electric four-out relief appearance to finish the Phillies in a 6-2 win Thursday night in the deciding Game 3 of their wild-card series.

stories.title: Wilson leaves fan drama on 'back burner,' drops 36 points as Aces oust Fever
stories.summary: A'ja Wilson made sure her basketball spoke for itself Thursday night, as the four-time WNBA MVP scored 36 points to lead the defending champion Las Vegas Aces to a 94-83 victory over the Indiana Fever in the deciding Game 3 of the first round.

stories.title: Watson puts 3-1 Browns atop North after leading third straight winning drive
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson has the Browns atop the division at 3-1 after directing a game-winning drive for the third straight game Thursday night in a 27-24 win over the Steelers.

stories.title: Duren accepts 5-year, $200M deal as lengthy standoff with Pistons ends
stories.summary: Jalen Duren agreed to a five-year, $200 million fully guaranteed contract to return to the Pistons, agent Chafie Fields told ESPN's Shams Charania ahead of a Thursday night deadline the All-NBA center had to accept a 1-year qualifying offer.
